name: whwice
description: ratio wh/wice of the widths of holes in ice lenses to ice lenses (tuning parameter; Colbeck 1975 gives no value)

name: liqmax
description: maximum liquid water fraction in the snow per pore-space volume (SOMARS/RACMO use 2%)

name: do_no_darcy
description: 1 = turn off the slower Darcy flow (flush liqexcess down immediately)

name: old_perc
description: 1 = use the old percolation scheme and superimposed ice function

name: Ck
description: fraction of the water available for refreezing that refreezes during one time step

name: ConductionModel
description: 1 = conduction-only model

name: calc_CLliq
description: 1 = use Coleou and Lesaffre (1998) to calculate the irreducible water content

name: rho_pco
description: pore close-off density (determines when a layer becomes impermeable)

name: pemi
description: HIRHAM value of surface emissivity

name: zdifiz
description: temperature diffusivity of ice

name: icemax
description: ice fraction that determines when to stop counting snow depth

name: cro_1
description: runoff time-scale parameter c1 (Zuo & Oerlemans 1996; Reijmer et al.). Z&O: 1.5 d; Reijmer (MAR): 0.05 d; Lefebre: 0.33 d

name: cro_2
description: runoff time-scale parameter c2 (Zuo & Oerlemans 1996)

name: cro_3
description: runoff time-scale parameter c3 (Zuo & Oerlemans 1996)

name: a_rho
description: parameter a in RFO's surface snow density parameterization

name: b_rho
description: parameter b in RFO's surface snow density parameterization

name: c_rho
description: parameter c in RFO's surface snow density parameterization

name: d_rho
description: parameter d in RFO's surface snow density parameterization

name: nuw
description: kinematic viscosity of water at 0 degC

name: kice
description: permeability of ice lenses

name: dgrainNew
description: grain diameter of newly fallen snow

name: delta_time
description: model time step (overwritten in main_SEB_firn.py from the forcing frequency)

name: eps
description: tuning parameter

name: missing_value
description: missing value flag

name: smallno
description: small number used in layer calculations

name: shallow_firn_lim
description: depth above which layer merging is discouraged

name: deep_firn_lim
description: depth below which layer merging is favoured and splitting is discouraged

name: thick_crit
description: layer thickness at which the thickness-based splitting criterion reaches its maximum

name: new_bottom_lay
description: thickness of the ice layer added at the bottom when no layer can be split

name: max_lay_thick
description: maximum layer thickness

name: min_tot_thick
description: minimum total column thickness for layers to be split (otherwise ice is added at the bottom)

name: merge_crit_temp
description: temperature difference per 0.1 m w.e. above which two layers are not considered similar for merging

name: merge_crit_dens
description: firn density difference per 0.1 m w.e. above which two layers are not considered similar for merging

name: merge_crit_gsize
description: grain size difference per 0.1 m w.e. above which two layers are not considered similar for merging

name: merge_crit_rel_lwc
description: relative liquid water content difference per 0.1 m w.e. above which two layers are not considered similar for merging

name: merge_crit_rel_snic
description: relative ice content difference per m w.e. above which two layers are not considered similar for merging

name: new_lay_frac
description: number by which the average accumulation is divided to give the new layer thickness

name: lim_max_column
description: maximum column thickness (legacy)

name: hetero_percol
description: 1 = use the heterogeneous percolation parameterization

name: hetero_percol_dist
description: depth range to which meltwater is routed by heterogeneous percolation

name: hetero_percol_frac
description: fraction of the available water that is routed by heterogeneous percolation

name: hetero_percol_p
description: probability that heterogeneous percolation occurs

name: crit_diff_grain
description: grain size difference that stops heterogeneous percolation

name: ice_threshold
description: ice fraction that stops heterogeneous percolation

name: t_runoff_fact
description: multiplication factor applied to the runoff time scale

name: a_dens
description: scaling factor on the snow viscosity in the densification scheme

name: b_dens
description: scaling factor on the density dependence of the snow viscosity in the densification scheme
